title: Crimson Hero
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Fifteen-year-old Nobara Sumiyoshi lives for volleyball, but her family wants her to inherit the role of 'young mistress' at their traditional Japanese restaurant. She transfers to Crimson Field High, known for volleyball, with help from her aunt Momoko, while her mother works to keep her off the court. The long series follows her team, dorm life and a slow romance.
life_message: A good life means pursuing a calling with hard work and teamwork, even against family expectations.
